biography.en:
She is a Chinese manhua artist. She is best known for creating the comics Zi Bu Yu and Chang Ge Xing, and five million copies of her works have been sold as of 2018. Her art has been noted for its classical style, and have been met with positive reception in both China and Japan. In 2008, she won the Gold Prize in the girls’ category of the fiction section, the Fifth OACC Golden Dragon Award Original Animation & Comic Competition, the biggest one in China of its kind.

Her interests had included painting and comic-reading since she was a child, and she was eventually inspired to make her own comics in high school. She published her first work, titled Cheng Zhang, in the Beijing Cartoon magazine, receiving an encouraging, handwritten reply by her editorial teacher. After graduating from university, she moved to Beijing and briefly worked in advertising before quitting to focus on her own comics. During this time, she became engrossed in drawing, seldom leaving her apartment as she lived on a modest income.

Wi-Lan is a girl born into a poor fisherman's family. She yearns to go to a particular, high-standard private high school. She is overjoyed when she receives her acceptance letter, but her happiness quickly turns to dismay when she gets teased and pranked, and becomes the laughter of the whole school for being the poorest kid there.  
  
However, the arrival of a new transfer student, San-Yue, soon brightens her days. He's so handsome that, along with all the other girls, Wi-Lan can't help but fall for him. But then, when she gathers up her courage and confesses to him, he runs off without saying anything…?! Apparently, he and his family are hiding a dark secret…

Reborn in the lower realm, he founded the Tianxuan Sect and vowed to return to the immortal world for revenge. A million years have passed, and his disciples have ascended one after another, becoming dominant figures in the immortal realm. As for him, he has just ascended to the immortal world and is a novice. Su Xuan pretends to be foolish and plays the fool while secretly gathering his disciples and rebuilding the Tianxuan Sect, with the aim of reaching the pinnacle of the immortal realm once again!

description.en: Office worker Li Yitai dies unexpectedly while working overtime and is taken to the underworld. However, upon checking the Book of Life and Death, they discover that his name isn’t listed. He doesn’t officially exist, and therefore cannot be reincarnated. Through a twist of fate, he becomes a “ghost errand runner"" and is tasked with capturing evil spirits. In the process, he also begins to uncover the hidden truth about himself.

The strongest mercenary killer, Fang Zichen, has gotten tired of killing and decides to leave his old life behind. He hides his identity and goes to G city to live out his life peacefully. However, he ends up working for Qiao Tianna's security company. Thus, he begins his thrilling and adventurous life as a bodyguard!

description.en: He had been waiting in the orphanage when his biological father found him and decided to take him back to England. He thought he would live a blissful life with a family, but who knew his biological father only took him back in order to sell him off and pay his debt. He was sold off to his new and young adopted father who was a big shot known for his ruthlessness. While putting up an act with his "father," he also learned about his sorrowful past. Quite the shits and giggles will happen between this fake father-son pair.

The material turns out to be an ancient hi-tech gadget that, when folded properly, turns into a Genie. By further contract with the Genie, the folders could transform them self into super human known as "Origami Fighters". An evil organisation called "Black Union" tries to dominate the world by reviving origami fighters and ancient technology. It's up to Xiao Zhe and his friends to fight them as origami fighters!

A Regent who’s cold on the outside but passionate on the inside x A Chancellor who is unable to be open about his pain and suffering. The two of them used to be lovers who promised their futures to each other, but fell victim to the schemes of an evil scoundrel. When they meet again, they are on opposing sides. The Regent is bitter about the past betrayal of the Chancellor, and the Chancellor is being threatened to keep silent about the truth. When the two of them start working together again, the Regent swears to make the Chancellor pay. But beneath the hatred and grudges are two hearts that truly love each other. Will they be able to clear up their misunderstanding and walk towards the future hand-in-hand?
description.zh: 外冷内热摄政王X有苦难言小丞相，两人曾是互相许诺过未来的恋人，却被奸人挑拨，再相见时已处于对立阵营，摄政王恨当年丞相的背叛，丞相则受人威胁，无法说出真相，当两人再次共事，摄政王发誓要丞相好看！但充满恨意的外表下依旧是两颗互相爱慕的真心，两人是否能解除误会，携手向前？

description.en: Being reborn to be an A-lister, Su Xin’er thought the whole world would move a way for her to reach the pinnacle of life. Who knows the moment she opened her eyes, she was forced by the CEO to divorce! Her everyday is filled with scandals, and “Get out of entertainment circle” is pursued by the whole net. How poor Su Xin’er is!

altTitles.en: A Moonlit Night Among Flowers By The Spring River

description.en: A thousand years ago, a little boy lost his life to save a fox. A thousand years later, a scholar met a beautiful young man whose beauty amazed the country. Spring rivers and the alluring sceneries, is it just an illusory and a greedy dream in the mirror? And What exactly are love and eternity? Instead of being overwhelmed by thousands of thoughts, it is better to forget and to enjoy the time right now.
description.zh: 一千年前，一个小男孩为救一只小狐狸而失去生命。一千年后，一个书生遇到一个倾城倾国的美少年。 春江花月，旖旎风光，不过是虚幻而令人贪恋的镜中梦。爱与永恒究竟是什么？万千思绪，不如与我一同笑醉春风。本作改编自多多小说《春江花月夜》
description.pt-br: Mil anos atrás, um garotinho perdeu a vida para salvar uma raposa. Mil anos depois, um estudioso conheceu um belo jovem cuja beleza surpreendeu o país. Rios da primavera e as paisagens atraentes, é apenas um sonho ilusório e ganancioso? E o que exatamente é o amor e a eternidade? Em vez de ficar dominado por milhares de pensamentos, é melhor esquecer e aproveitar o momento.

description.en: A modern military doctor accidentally time-travelled during her mission. She became Feng Qingchen, the daughter of the late general of the ancient Tanglin Kingdom, and found herself in a bandit’s den.  With her life endangered, Feng Qingchen grabbed a scalpel from the medical system and killed a few bandits. When she left the bandit’s den and was about to wander the world free and unfettered, Wanyin, the servant girl of the owner of her body suddenly appeared to stall her. Feng Qingchen’s fiancé, Prince Luo, rushed over with his army just to find Feng Qingchen in dishevelled clothes. Doubting her chastity, he ordered her to commit suicide.

Various short stories from an upcoming Chinese Manhua artist, Benjamin.  
  
Two stories are in black & white, while two other stories are evidence for Benjamin's profound sense for colored illustrations.

Notre héroïne a un travail pour le moins inhabituel, elle est payée pour aider les hommes à se débarrasser de leurs maîtresse.  
Alors qu'elle cherche à échapper à des gardes du corps, elle finit dans la voiture d'un jeune homme qu'elle embrasse pour passer inaperçue.  
C'est alors qu'elle est conviée dans la demeure de sa famille qui l'avait abandonnée depuis des années.  
Son frère, chargé des affaires de la famille, n'est autre que le jeune homme qu'elle a embrassé !

Bearing a grudge against her evil sister and scumbag fiancé, she swears to never let history repeat itself. However, her fiancé's brother, Chen Yi – a two-faced man, seems to be paying extra attention to her...
